sentences.en: There was always too much superfluous writing in his essays.
sentences.zh: 他的文章里总是有太多冗长的内容。

sentences.en: Judy spent hours on end writing and rewriting her essay.
sentences.zh: 朱迪花了好几个小时反复修改她的文章。

sentences.en: He gave us an essay to write during the vacation.
sentences.zh: 他在假期布置了一篇作文让我们写。

senses.zh: 短文，散文；论说文，小品文
